_comment: Canonical Right Suite API host and trust-root contract, owned by RightKit. Edit only here; scripts/gen-suite-api.mjs writes every projection (rightkit-license suite_api_generated.rs, @rightkit/app-update suite-api.generated.ts, @rightkit/release suite-api.generated.mjs, RightKitSwift RightSuiteAPI.generated.swift) and a byte copy under crates/rightkit-license/test-vectors/. Path templates use {app} for the app key (filled by RightKit) and Tauri's {{target}} placeholder (filled by the updater at runtime). Hosts are bare hostnames; origins include the scheme. clientPaths are every route the native licence client calls (rightkit-license client/wire.rs, account.rs, subject.rs); {app} is the app key. licensePublicKeyHex is the Ed25519 key that verifies every suite licence token. updaterPublicKeys lists every minisign key a suite app accepts for updates (kid = the 16-hex key id, publicKey = the base64 text tauri.conf.json carries, notAfter = last UTC day the key is accepted); updaterSigningKeyId names the one key releases are signed with today. Rotation: add the new key here, ship a release signed by the old key, then change updaterSigningKeyId (docs/SUITE-TRUST-ROOTS.md). An app entry may omit licenseHost (not declared yet) or artifactHosts (no artifact hosts declared). Ember is not a suite app: it has its own updater key.
